mapper.sql: n.id, n.user_id, n.patient_id, n.patient_name_snapshot AS patient_name, n.type, n.title, n.content, CASE WHEN n.type = 'CONSULTATION' THEN NULLIF(n.payload ->> 'consultationId', '')::bigint END AS consultation_id, n.read_at, n.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient WHERE id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM patient_user_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL )
SELECT name FROM patient WHERE id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pur.user_id, cr.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, reply.content FROM consult_record cr INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = cr.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN patient_user_relation pur ON pur.patient_id = cr.patient_id AND pur.relationship = 'SELF' AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cm.content FROM consultation_message cm WHERE cm.consult_id = cr.id AND cm.sender_type = 'DOCTOR' AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC, cm.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) reply ON TRUE WHERE cr.id = #{consultationId} AND cr.appointment_id IS NULL
AND cr.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT mp.id AS business_id, pur.user_id, mp.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, mp.next_remind_at AS due_at, mp.reminder_times::text AS reminder_times_json FROM medication_plan mp INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = mp.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN patient_user_relation pur ON pur.patient_id = mp.patient_id AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN notification n ON n.user_id = pur.user_id AND n.event_id = CONCAT('REMINDER:', mp.id, ':', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM mp.next_remind_at) * 1000)::bigint) WHERE mp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mp.reminder_enabled = true AND mp.next_remind_at IS NOT NULL AND mp.next_remind_at <= #{now} AND mp.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.id IS NULL

SELECT fp.id AS business_id, pur.user_id, fp.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, fp.remind_at AS due_at FROM follow_up_plan fp INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = fp.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN patient_user_relation pur ON pur.patient_id = fp.patient_id AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN notification n ON n.user_id = pur.user_id AND n.event_id = CONCAT('FOLLOW_UP:', fp.id, ':', FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM fp.remind_at) * 1000)::bigint) WHERE fp.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND fp.remind_at IS NOT NULL AND fp.remind_at <= #{now} AND fp.deleted_at IS NULL AND n.id IS NULL
SELECT FROM notification n WHERE n.id = #{notificationId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, patient_id, patient_name_snapshot, type, title, content, payload, event_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{patientId}, #{patientNameSnapshot}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{eventId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id) WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
